## Windows app: one file that stays the same
Windows Defender could flag the Windows app as a threat after an update. Its check looks at files it has never seen before, and every release used to bring a brand-new, unsigned app file.

- **The desktop app has its own version (1.27.0):** the app file is only rebuilt when the desktop app itself changes. Every other release puts the exact same file into the installer, so Windows keeps recognising it
- **Fewer updates for the desktop app:** Settings → Updates only offers a desktop update when the app itself changed. Server, web player and phone updates are unaffected
- **Cleanup:** the one-time move of settings from the old Musik name was removed from the app

## Install
- **Update server:** Settings → Updates → Update now (or run the Proxmox script)
- **Android:** Settings → Updates → Update now
- **Windows:** Settings → Updates, or run the new installer
- **Linux:** Settings → Updates
